item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera lives in a village next to a forest in Maharashtra. After two years of poor rainfall, many trees were cut and the waterholes inside the forest dried up. Her family noticed wild animals such as nilgai and wild boar entering their farm and damaging the crops. Which statement best explains why the animals moved into the farm?

options.A: The animals preferred the taste of crops, so they chose the farm over the forest.
options.B: The loss of vegetation and drying of waterholes reduced food and water in the forest, so the animals searched for these resources near humans.
options.C: The animals were driven out by tourists visiting the village during the festival season.
options.D: The crops released a smell that confused the animals and made them lose their way in the forest.
